eval.title: Coupang Stock Analysis - Korea e-commerce!

call.headline_quote: in this case cang is still risky there is still room for downside but there is still room for total disaster if they can't keep margins up

base_metric.name: fcf_per_share
base_metric.quote: if we give it a normal valuation at free cash flows that they discuss then p ratio 15 they should be making 2 billion

scenarios.name: normal
scenarios.quote: if we give it a normal valuation at free cash flows that they discuss then p ratio 15 they should be making 2 billion

reasons.claim: To double the stock in 3-4 years profits need to quadruple, which requires tripling or doubling revenue on current margins, and he finds that unlikely.
reasons.quote: they need to Triple their revenues on current margins or at least double and will that happen in four years I find that unlikely

data_check.gap_note: not in our data: target market cap, target net income

reasons.claim: Growth has slowed sharply from doubling every year to low-teens, a big consequence for a story priced on hypergrowth.
reasons.quote: we see here extremely fast growth doubling every year especially with the pandemic but now we have the first big big slowdown with low teen growth rates

reasons.claim: Competitive pressure from AliExpress and reliance on a vague 'wow element' rather than a real cost/scale advantage will compress margins.
reasons.quote: if there is a competitor your margin will get thinner and if that competitor can work cheaper better faster on a bigger scale than you have then you know your margins might not go that far

reasons.claim: At the current 66 P/E, the market is pricing in growth and margin outcomes that require heroic assumptions to justify.

data_check.gap_note: he says 66, as-of -305.6 (FY2022); annual vs TTM or a different definition

reasons.claim: Owning something just because a famous investor like Druckenmiller owns it is misleading since he bought pre-IPO at a much lower price than retail can access now.
reasons.quote: you must not get confused when you look at these sites they say that he bought at IPO no if you look at data they bought in the first rounds

external_facts_used: Druckenmiller's 13F stake in Coupang and his pre-IPO purchase history
Coupang conference call comments on Taiwan expansion, margin expansion, and cash flow vs EBITDA
Analyst (Barclays) question on AliExpress competition and CEO's 'wow element' response

critic.notes: ok. Reason 4's 'heroic assumptions' phrasing is an interpretive gloss on his P/E 66 vs P/E 15 argument, but the underlying claim is his.
